name: Naga
description: Powerful magic users who claimed dragon ancestry and ruled the Sultai; many villages now have a naga protector.

description_citations.text: "Sultai Brood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Naga creature type is made obsolete with Modern Horizons 3, with all naga errata'd to Snake.
timeline.quote: The decision was made to obsolete the type and errata all instances of Naga to Snake .

citation.text: "Naga", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rakshasa and naga manipulate Tasigur into offending them, causing their defection.
timeline.quote: Tasigur was manipulated by the rakshasa and naga into a series of events that eventually led him to offend them, causing their defection.

citation.text: "Sultai Brood", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the new timeline, Silumgar forces the naga into slavery as a result of Tasigur's pact; after his overthrow the Sultai revive.
timeline.quote: Naga were forced into becoming slaves, undead or otherwise, by Silumgar as the result of a pact Tasigur made with the dragon.

citation.text: "Naga", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Khudal and Shidiqi abandon Tasigur with the prophecy 'And so the Sultai fall'; the naga and rakshasa leave the Sultai.
timeline.quote: And so the Sultai fall," the naga echoed, and she was gone, too.

citation.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
citation.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Sidisi rallies the naga and gains the allegiance of many sibsig, though she remains loyal to Silumgar for now.
timeline.quote: Sidisi has been able to rally the naga and gain the allegiance of a large number of sibsig zombies

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sultai subjects foment resistance against Silumgar, supported by dissident naga necromancy.
timeline.quote: his subjects were some of the first in Tarkir to foment resistance against their dragonlord

citation.text: "Sultai Brood", section "Revival of the Sultai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sidisi reveals she keeps a collection of poisons in the hole where her heart was, waiting for the day to take back power and make the naga rulers.
timeline.quote: On that day, she would take the power the dragon had stolen from her, and the naga would become what they were always meant to be—rulers of these lands.

citation.text: "The Poisoned Heart" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2015.

relations.note: She is an undead naga who rose through the ranks of the Naga.
relations.quote: rising through the ranks of Naga in her attempts to gain power

citation.text: "The Poisoned Heart" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2015.

relations.quote: led by the merciless Sidisi , queen of the naga

citation.text: "Naga", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Scaled necromancers who control the zombies and withdraw their support from Tasigur.

citation.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
citation.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.

pages_say.description: Serpentine translators in Silumgar's clan, who claim kinship with dragons but hold minimal power.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: Scaled people who cannot produce the dragons' precise language and whom Sidisi hopes will rule these lands.

citation.text: "The Poisoned Heart" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2015.

pages_say.description: Humanoid snake-like species with serpentine lower bodies; an obsolete creature type found on Tarkir, Amonkhet and Ravnica.
